comparison.objective: Place a pepper seedling plug, backfill it evenly, firm it, and leave it upright without damage; the candidate adjusts and locks a robot gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2106 tests delicate plug handling, granular backfilling around a held object, support formation, and avoidance of stem or leaf damage. The candidate tests rigid hand-tool alignment, screw-and-nut countertorque, regrasping, and articulated verification.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2106 grades plug depth and tilt, four-sided soil level, fill percentage, spill, firmness under a side push, release, and plant damage. The candidate grades opening angle, locking and retention, three-cycle return, drift, and tool clearance. No material rubric details are missing; the soil-clod and plant-damage approximations are disclosed.
comparison.reason: Granular backfilling and damage-sensitive stabilization of a plant are meaningfully different from calibrated rigid-mechanism adjustment and locknut retention.
